summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds set_window_title() gated only on is_terminal, returning bool; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions, so the changes are verified by reading only.
